channel.title: Tuoi Tre News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Tuoi Tre News (tuoitrenews.vn)

item.title: Ho Chi Minh City officially opens int’l financial center
item.description: Ho Chi Minh City on Wednesday officially launched the Vietnam International Financial Center in Ho Chi Minh City (VIFC-HCMC) at its headquarters at 8 Nguyen Hue Street, Saigon Ward.

item.title: Vietnam, Singapore agree to expand VSIP network, boost cooperation on international financial center
item.description: Vietnam and Singapore have agreed to expand the Vietnam–Singapore Industrial Park (VSIP) network and enhance cooperation in developing Vietnam’s recently established international financial center, while deepening ties in other key sectors.

item.title: 11 sentenced in Ho Chi Minh City over coffin-carrying stunt to promote clothing on social media
item.description: Eleven defendants have been sentenced for staging a coffin-carrying procession in downtown Ho Chi Minh City to film a social media video aimed at boosting online views and promoting clothing sales.

item.title: Vietnam police dismantle major drug ring, arrest 11 traffickers
item.description: Police in Dong Nai Province, southern Vietnam have busted a large-scale drug trafficking ring, detaining 11 suspects and seizing some five kilograms of narcotics.

item.title: Ho Chi Minh City’s first museum launches online ticketing
item.description: The War Remnants Museum has become the first museum in Ho Chi Minh City to introduce an online ticketing system, marking a significant step toward modernizing visitor services and ending long lines at the entrance.

item.title: Canadian police identify 18-year-old woman as suspect in mass school shooting
item.description: OTTAWA - The suspect in a deadly school shooting in western Canada was an 18-year-old woman with mental health issues who killed her mother and stepbrother before attacking her former school, police said on Wednesday, but investigators did not offer a motive for one of the worst mass slaughters in Canadian history.

item.title: Ho Chi Minh City launches first cross-sea UAV postal route
item.description: The Ho Chi Minh City Department of Science and Technology, in collaboration with Vietnam Post Corporation, and CT UAV Joint Stock Company, on Thursday opened the city’s first cross-sea postal route using unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) that connects Can Gio Commune with Vung Tau Ward.

item.title: Teacher dies after Thailand school shooting
item.description: BANGKOK - A female teacher died on Thursday in southern Thailand's Hat Yai district after a gunman opened fire at a school where she worked, the provincial administration said on social media.

item.title: Dawson's Creek star James Van Der Beek dies at 48
item.description: James Van Der Beek, the star of 1990s teen drama "Dawson's Creek," died on Wednesday at the age of 48 after a battle with cancer, his wife announced on social media.
